meta.title: City Siege 3D - Town Hall Progression, Research Labs & Builder System Master Catalog

rules.levelOneBaseline: 2 Police Stations, 2 Petrol Pumps, 6 Roadblock Obstacles, 3 Attacking Fortified Gates

builder_system.description: Labours are dedicated construction workers who erect new structures, upgrade existing fortifications, and repair battle damage. Every active build or upgrade job requires 1 free Labour. Players can 'Hire a Labour' as Town Hall levels advance, scaling from 2 starter labours up to 7 total master constructors.

mechanics.concurrencyRule: 1 Labour per active construction or upgrade task.
mechanics.busyBehavior: When all available labours are busy, new builds and upgrades are blocked until a task finishes or is completed instantly.

unlock_schedule.title: Hire a Labour: Apprentice
unlock_schedule.desc: Foundational labour provided automatically upon starting your first settlement.

unlock_schedule.title: Hire a Labour: Journeyman
unlock_schedule.desc: Second starter labour included in baseline Town Hall 1 layout to enable dual parallel construction.

unlock_schedule.title: Master Carpenter
unlock_schedule.desc: Unlocks at Town Hall 2 to support expansion into sniper towers and vehicle research.

unlock_schedule.title: Architect Engineer
unlock_schedule.desc: Unlocks at Town Hall 4 for heavy industrial electrification and petrochemical construction.

unlock_schedule.title: Industrial Foreman
unlock_schedule.desc: Unlocks at Town Hall 6 to manage high-tech laser obelisks and urban skyscraper development.

unlock_schedule.title: Cybernetic Constructor
unlock_schedule.desc: Unlocks at Town Hall 9. Automated cybernetic builder cyborg capable of rapid nanite assembly.

unlock_schedule.title: Quantum Nano-Assembler
unlock_schedule.desc: Unlocks at Town Hall 12. Transcendent quantum particle constructor synthesizing planetary shields.

vehicle_lab.name: Vehicle Tuning Lab
vehicle_lab.desc: High-octane automotive performance garage. Upgrades vehicle top speed, acceleration, nitro boost, hydraulic jump height, and chassis armor.

engine_speed.name: Top Speed & Turbo Injection
engine_speed.desc: Increases vehicle maximum velocity along straightaways and highways.

acceleration.name: Torque & Powertrain
acceleration.desc: Improves 0-60 acceleration, quick recovery after tight turns, and hill-climbing power.

nitro_boost.name: Nitrous Oxide Reserves
nitro_boost.desc: Increases nitro top-speed boost multiplier and extends nitro burn duration.

armor_plating.name: Chassis Armor & Roll Cage
armor_plating.desc: Increases vehicle maximum health points and reduces damage received from ramming roadblocks and police gunfire.

jump_thrusters.name: Hydraulic Jump Suspension
jump_thrusters.desc: Increases Big Jump height, air hang-time, and forward clearance distance over police cruisers and barriers.

tire_traction.name: Performance Treads & Drift Control
tire_traction.desc: Eliminates unwanted skidding, improves steering responsiveness, and accelerates drift recovery.

weapons_lab.name: Weapons & Munitions Lab
weapons_lab.desc: Heavy munitions and explosive research foundry. Upgrades bomb blast radius, explosion damage, guided missile tracking, and EMP disruption duration.

bomb_blast_radius.name: Explosive Shockwave Radius
bomb_blast_radius.desc: Increases the blast diameter of vehicle-dropped bombs to destroy clusters of roadblocks and multiple buildings simultaneously.

bomb_damage.name: High-Explosive Payload Damage
bomb_damage.desc: Dramatically multiplies structural demolition damage against reinforced buildings, petrol pumps, and police cruisers.

shrapnel_burst.name: Secondary Shrapnel Fragmentation
shrapnel_burst.desc: Fires outward high-velocity fragmentation pellets upon bomb detonation to ignite surrounding hazards.

missile_seeker.name: Rocket Guidance & Warhead Speed
missile_seeker.desc: Accelerates missile projectile velocity and enhances tracking lock-on against moving police interceptors.

emp_shockwave.name: EMP Pulse Disruption
emp_shockwave.desc: Disables nearby police cruiser engines, sirens, and automated gate turrets with a high-voltage electromagnetic shockwave.

reload_speed.name: Automated Ammo Feeder
reload_speed.desc: Reduces cooldown between heavy bomb drops and missile salvos.
